decisions.rationale: The collapsed structure and duplication come from the shared derivation tool. Repository PR https://github.com/JesterCharles/pep-technology-content/pull/13 fixes it. After it lands, regenerate all nine artifact.md files with the tool and review them. Never hand-edit derived Markdown.

Restore the complete goal 'Heading is the team's choice, with no markers' in the merge practice's data-static-alt. Find and fix the cause of the apostrophe truncation (escaping in authored data-static-alt), regenerate artifact.md, and check that every static goal matches the live goal.

Restore both complete terminal goals ("Undo C3's change with a new commit" and "C4's change kept in the staging area") in data-static-alt, regenerate, and compare every static terminal goal against the live goals.

Smallest compliant option, keeping the captain-confirmed page behaviour: narrow review objective o2 and the cumulative-review wording on the page and in topic.json to the workflow the page actually checks. Do not claim integration it does not test, and add no new checks or syllabus. Record the change in content-changes evidence.

Qualify stash pop in the teaching, recap, cheat sheet and GIFT item: pop removes the entry after a successful apply; if conflicts prevent a clean apply, the entry stays and the learner resolves the conflicts, then drops it manually.

Change the categorical recap and matching GIFT feedback to: 'A common conflict happens when both branches change the same area and Git cannot combine the changes automatically.' Keep the exercise unchanged.
